title: Use Sunscreen
description: Apply sunscreen with SPF 30 or higher at least 20 minutes before stepping out to protect your skin from harmful UV rays.

title: Stay Hydrated
description: Drink plenty of water and fresh juices daily to keep your body hydrated and maintain your skin's natural glow during the intense heat.

title: Use Light Moisturizers
description: Swap out heavy creams for a water-based or gel moisturizer. It will keep your skin feeling fresh and hydrated without being sticky.
